verdicts.reason: A drops the SOLSTICE logo; the header is cut down to a stray dark sliver in the top-left. Its body copy is squeezed into a narrow right-hand column that wraps one to three words per line. The legal text sits above the oversized CTA, so the layout feels chaotic. B keeps the logo header and a clean headline, but the CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill next to legal text. The body copy is much bigger than the CTA, so the hierarchy is broken. B is the slightly better resize because it keeps the brand and its structure is more coherent.
